ui.longDesc: UBX-CFG-NAV5 dynamic platform model (u-blox dynModel enum: 0=Portable, 2=Stationary, 3=Pedestrian, 4=Automotive, 5=Sea, 6=Airborne <1g, 7=Airborne <2g, 8=Airborne <4g, 9=Wrist, 10=Bike, 11=Mower, 12=E-scooter). A lower value lets the receiver apply more internal smoothing at the cost of slower response to real high-g maneuvers. Read once at GPS module boot; changing it requires a reboot to take effect.

UBX-CFG-NAV5 static-hold speed threshold. Below this ground speed the receiver actively suppresses GPS-noise-induced position jitter. Set to 0 to disable static hold. Read once at GPS module boot; changing it requires a reboot to take effect.
